blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 TR70 的目的與範圍：本報告如何定義無菌製造設施的清潔與消毒程序框架。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of TR70: how the report defines a framework of cleaning and disinfection procedures for aseptic manufacturing facilities.

blocks.zh: 區分三類抗微生物劑：Sanitizer（殺菌劑）、Disinfectant（消毒劑）與 Sporicide（殺孢子劑）的定義差異、作用對象及適用環境等級。
blocks.en: Distinguish the three classes of antimicrobial agents: how sanitizers, disinfectants and sporicides differ in definition, target organisms and suitable environment grades.

blocks.zh: 掌握關鍵術語定義：理解 Aseptic Processing Area（APA）、Contact Time（接觸時間）、Bioburden Load、Log Reduction 等核心概念。
blocks.en: Master the key terms: Aseptic Processing Area (APA), contact time, bioburden load, log reduction and other core concepts.

blocks.zh: 辨識主要法規依據：包括 FDA 21 CFR Part 211、FDA 無菌指南 (2004)、EU GMP Annex 1、USP <1072> 及 ISO 14698 的相關要求。
blocks.en: Identify the main regulatory sources: the relevant requirements of FDA 21 CFR Part 211, the FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004), EU GMP Annex 1, USP <1072> and ISO 14698.

blocks.zh: 了解稽核準備的核心要點：為什麼藥廠必須提供藥劑選擇的書面依據，以及內部資格驗證 (in-house qualification) 的監管期望。
blocks.en: Understand the core points of audit preparation: why a firm must provide a written rationale for agent selection, and the regulatory expectations for in-house qualification.

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: TR70 的核心定位
blocks.en: The Core Position of TR70

blocks.zh: TR70 是目前最完整的製藥無菌設施清潔與消毒實務指引之一。它不是法規本身，但其建議被全球監管機構在稽核時視為「業界最佳實務」的參考標準。
blocks.en: TR70 is one of the most complete practical guides to cleaning and disinfection in pharmaceutical aseptic facilities. It is not a regulation itself, but regulators worldwide treat its recommendations as a reference standard for "industry best practice" during inspections.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，每當稽核員詢問「你們如何選擇消毒劑？」，能夠引用 TR70 框架並展示系統性驗證文件，是通過稽核的關鍵。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, whenever an auditor asks "How do you select your disinfectants?", being able to cite the TR70 framework and show systematic qualification documentation is the key to passing the audit.

blocks.zh: 範圍邊界：非產品接觸面
blocks.en: Scope Boundary: Non-Product-Contact Surfaces

blocks.zh: TR70 聚焦於地板、牆壁、天花板、設備外表面等非產品接觸面 (non-product-contact surfaces) 的清潔。
blocks.en: TR70 focuses on cleaning of non-product-contact surfaces such as floors, walls, ceilings and external equipment surfaces.

blocks.zh: 產品接觸面（如配液罐內壁、管路）另由 TR29 和 TR49 規範，在 TR70 學習時需留意這個邊界。
blocks.en: Product-contact surfaces (such as the inner walls of compounding tanks and piping) are covered separately by TR29 and TR49; keep this boundary in mind when studying TR70.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院與手術室的差異
blocks.en: Analogy: Hospital vs. Operating Room

blocks.zh: 想像 TR70 就像「手術室清潔 SOP 指南」——不是說如何清洗手術器械（那是 CIP/COP 的事），而是說如何消毒手術室的地面、門把、推車，讓環境維持在微生物可控範圍。
blocks.en: Think of TR70 as an "operating room cleaning SOP guide". It does not say how to wash the surgical instruments (that is a CIP/COP matter); it says how to disinfect the floors, door handles and carts of the operating room so that the environment stays within microbiologically controlled limits.

blocks.zh: TR70 vs TR29 vs TR49 — 三份報告的分工
blocks.en: TR70 vs. TR29 vs. TR49: How the Three Reports Divide the Work

blocks.zh: TR70：設施環境（牆壁、地板、設備外表面）
blocks.en: TR70: facility environment (walls, floors, external equipment surfaces)

blocks.zh: TR29：小分子藥品產品接觸面清潔驗證
blocks.en: TR29: cleaning validation of product-contact surfaces for small-molecule drugs

blocks.zh: TR49：生技藥品（大分子）清潔驗證
blocks.en: TR49: cleaning validation for biological (large-molecule) drugs

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語解析
blocks.en: Key Terms Explained

blocks.zh: 三劑層次：最重要的區別
blocks.en: The Three Levels of Agent: The Most Important Distinction

blocks.zh: TR70 最核心的概念就是這三者的層次差異，稽核時常被問到：
blocks.en: The core concept of TR70 is the difference in level among these three agents, and auditors often ask about it:

blocks.zh: Sanitizer（殺菌劑）
blocks.en: Sanitizer

blocks.zh: 降低細菌數至安全水平（通常 3-log 減少）。不殺孢子。適用於低潔淨度區域或輔助步驟。
blocks.en: Reduces bacterial counts to a safe level (typically a 3-log reduction). Does not kill spores. Suitable for lower-cleanliness areas or as a supporting step.

blocks.zh: Disinfectant（消毒劑）
blocks.en: Disinfectant

blocks.zh: 消滅活性形態微生物（vegetative organisms）。不殺孢子。Grade C/D 主要使用，Grade B 也使用。
blocks.en: Destroys vegetative organisms. Does not kill spores. Mainly used in Grade C/D areas, and also used in Grade B.

blocks.zh: Sporicide（殺孢子劑）
blocks.en: Sporicide

blocks.zh: 消滅所有活性微生物 及 孢子。Grade A/B 無菌環境必須定期使用，因為消毒劑無法消除孢子。
blocks.en: Destroys all vegetative microorganisms and spores. Must be used periodically in Grade A/B aseptic environments, because disinfectants cannot eliminate spores.

blocks.zh: Log Reduction 實務計算
blocks.en: Log Reduction in Practice

blocks.zh: 如果表面有 10,000 CFU（10<sup>4</sup>）：
blocks.en: If a surface carries 10,000 CFU (10<sup>4</sup>):

blocks.zh: 1-log 減少 → 剩下 1,000 CFU
blocks.en: 1-log reduction → 1,000 CFU remain

blocks.zh: 3-log 減少 → 剩下 10 CFU（Sanitizer 標準）
blocks.en: 3-log reduction → 10 CFU remain (sanitizer standard)

blocks.zh: 6-log 減少 → 剩下 0.01 CFU（滅菌標準，SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup>）
blocks.en: 6-log reduction → 0.01 CFU remain (sterilization standard, SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup>)

blocks.zh: TR70 要求的 3-log 減少是 Sanitizer 的最低門檻；Sporicide 的要求通常更高。
blocks.en: The 3-log reduction required by TR70 is the minimum threshold for a sanitizer; the requirement for a sporicide is usually higher.

blocks.zh: Contact Time — 為什麼不能提早擦乾？
blocks.en: Contact Time: Why You Cannot Wipe the Surface Dry Early

blocks.zh: 想像消毒劑是「浸泡殺蟲劑」——藥劑必須維持濕潤狀態一段時間才能完成作用。如果表面提早乾燥，接觸時間不足，即使用了正確藥劑，效果也無法保證。這是操作 SOP 中必須規定最短接觸時間，並在驗證時確認的原因。
blocks.en: Think of a disinfectant as a "soaking insecticide": the agent must stay wet for a period of time to do its work. If the surface dries early, the contact time is insufficient, and even with the right agent the effect cannot be assured. This is why the operating SOP must specify a minimum contact time and why it must be confirmed during validation.

blocks.zh: APA 分區 vs. 藥劑選擇邏輯
blocks.en: APA Zoning vs. Agent Selection Logic

blocks.zh: Aseptic Processing Area (APA) 包含多個潔淨等級區域，EU GMP 以 Grade A/B/C/D 定義：
blocks.en: The Aseptic Processing Area (APA) contains several cleanliness grades, which EU GMP defines as Grade A/B/C/D:

blocks.zh: Grade A（充填區）：Sporicide 必須定期使用；消毒劑輪替使用
blocks.en: Grade A (filling zone): a sporicide must be used periodically; disinfectants are rotated

blocks.zh: Grade B（背景環境）：Sporicide + Disinfectant 輪替
blocks.en: Grade B (background environment): sporicide and disinfectant used in rotation

blocks.zh: Grade C/D（支援區）：Disinfectant 為主，Sanitizer 可輔助
blocks.en: Grade C/D (support areas): mainly disinfectant, with a sanitizer as a supplement

blocks.zh: Transfer Disinfection（移入消毒）
blocks.en: Transfer Disinfection

blocks.zh: 當物料、設備或容器從低潔淨區移入高潔淨區前，必須進行表面消毒處理。這個程序需要經過驗證，確認接觸時間與消毒劑有效。是稽核中常見查核點。
blocks.en: When materials, equipment or containers move from a lower-grade area into a higher-grade area, their surfaces must be disinfected first. This procedure needs to be validated to confirm the contact time and the effectiveness of the disinfectant. It is a common audit checkpoint.

blocks.zh: VPHP（氣態過氧化氫）的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Status of VPHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide)

blocks.zh: VPHP 是目前 Grade A/B 隔離器 (Isolator) 和 RABS 生物去汙 (bio-decontamination) 的主要方式。TR70 將其列入術語，後續章節有深入討論。其作用機制包含孢子殺滅，屬於 Sporicide 層級。
blocks.en: VPHP is currently the main method of bio-decontamination for Grade A/B isolators and RABS. TR70 lists it in the glossary and discusses it in depth in later sections. Its mechanism of action includes spore killing, so it belongs to the sporicide level.

blocks.zh: 分類解析與實務應用
blocks.en: Classification and Practical Application

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：商業登記驗證 vs. 製藥內部資格驗證
blocks.en: Key Distinction: Commercial Registration Testing vs. Pharmaceutical In-House Qualification

blocks.zh: 市面上消毒劑標示的有效性聲明（如「殺滅 99.9% 細菌」）是在高菌量環境下測試的結果（醫院、食品加工廠）。
blocks.en: The efficacy claims on commercial disinfectant labels (such as "kills 99.9% of bacteria") come from testing under high-bioburden conditions (hospitals, food processing plants).

blocks.zh: 製藥無菌廠的潔淨室菌量遠低於此，因此需要另行進行符合 GMP 實際條件的內部資格驗證 (in-house qualification)。這一點非常重要 — 不能直接引用廠商數據作為 GMP 依據。
blocks.en: The bioburden in a pharmaceutical aseptic cleanroom is far lower, so in-house qualification under actual GMP conditions must be performed separately. This is very important: supplier data cannot be cited directly as the GMP basis.

blocks.zh: 常用藥劑的特性速覽
blocks.en: Quick Overview of Common Agents

blocks.zh: IPA 70%（酒精）：Disinfectant。速效、易揮發、無殘留。不殺孢子。Grade B/C/D 日常消毒主力。
blocks.en: IPA 70% (alcohol): disinfectant. Fast-acting, volatile, leaves no residue. Does not kill spores. The workhorse for routine disinfection in Grade B/C/D.

blocks.zh: QAC（四級銨）：Disinfectant。持效時間長，但有累積抗藥性疑慮，需與其他類輪替。
blocks.en: QAC (quaternary ammonium compounds): disinfectant. Long residual action, but there is a concern about cumulative resistance, so it must be rotated with other classes.

blocks.zh: 次氯酸鈉（漂白水）：Sporicide 能力，但對金屬腐蝕性強，需控制濃度與接觸時間。
blocks.en: Sodium hypochlorite (bleach): has sporicidal capability, but is highly corrosive to metals, so concentration and contact time must be controlled.

blocks.zh: 過氧乙酸（PAA）：強效 Sporicide。廣用於 Grade A/B 環境及隔離器表面消毒。
blocks.en: Peracetic acid (PAA): potent sporicide. Widely used for surface disinfection in Grade A/B environments and isolators.

blocks.zh: VPHP：Sporicide，用於密閉空間整體生物去汙（隔離器、RABS）。需專業設備。
blocks.en: VPHP: sporicide, used for whole-enclosure bio-decontamination (isolators, RABS). Requires specialized equipment.

blocks.zh: 「輪替」策略的生態學邏輯
blocks.en: The Ecological Logic of a "Rotation" Strategy

blocks.zh: 如果長期只用同一種藥劑，環境中的微生物會逐漸篩選出抗性菌株，就像抗生素抗藥性問題一樣。TR70 建議定期輪替不同機制的消毒劑，目的是防止任何單一菌種發展出耐受性。在 CDMO 實務中，通常每 1-3 個月輪替一次，並記錄在 EM 趨勢分析報告中。
blocks.en: If the same agent is used for a long time, resistant strains will gradually be selected in the environment, just like the problem of antibiotic resistance. TR70 recommends periodically rotating disinfectants with different mechanisms of action to prevent any single species from developing tolerance. In CDMO practice the rotation usually occurs every 1-3 months and is documented in the EM trend analysis report.

blocks.zh: 基質 (Substrate) 相容性驗證
blocks.en: Substrate Compatibility Qualification

blocks.zh: 「在不鏽鋼上有效的藥劑」不一定對環氧樹脂地板或塑膠設備外殼有相同效果，也可能造成材料腐蝕或降解。
blocks.en: "An agent that works on stainless steel" does not necessarily work the same way on an epoxy floor or a plastic equipment housing, and it may also cause corrosion or degradation of the material.

blocks.zh: TR70 要求的內部資格驗證必須在實際使用的基質種類上進行測試，包括：不鏽鋼 (SS316L)、環氧樹脂地板、塗裝牆面、玻璃、聚碳酸酯等。
blocks.en: The in-house qualification required by TR70 must be tested on the types of substrate actually in use, including stainless steel (SS316L), epoxy flooring, coated walls, glass and polycarbonate.

blocks.zh: 稽核準備思考題
blocks.en: Audit Preparation Exercise

blocks.zh: 如果稽核員問：「你們的 Grade B 環境為什麼選用 X 消毒劑？」
blocks.en: If the auditor asks: "Why did you choose disinfectant X for your Grade B environment?"

blocks.zh: 標準答案框架：
blocks.en: Framework for a standard answer:

blocks.zh: 藥劑類別說明（Disinfectant / Sporicide）
blocks.en: Explanation of the agent class (disinfectant / sporicide)

blocks.zh: 針對哪些目標微生物（環境 EM 歷史分離株）
blocks.en: Which target microorganisms it addresses (environmental isolates from EM history)

blocks.zh: 內部資格驗證 (in-house qualification) 數據支持
blocks.en: Supporting in-house qualification data

blocks.zh: 輪替策略說明
blocks.en: Explanation of the rotation strategy

blocks.zh: Change control 記錄
blocks.en: Change control records

blocks.zh: 法規解析與稽核準備
blocks.en: Regulatory Analysis and Audit Preparation

blocks.zh: 最重要的監管原則：責任在廠商
blocks.en: The Most Important Regulatory Principle: The Responsibility Lies with the Manufacturer

blocks.zh: TR70 明確指出：「證明所用藥劑有效性的責任，在於個別製藥廠商。」
blocks.en: TR70 states clearly: "The responsibility for demonstrating the effectiveness of the agents used lies with the individual pharmaceutical manufacturer."

blocks.zh: 這意味著不能只說「我們用市售消毒劑，廠商說有效」。必須提供：
blocks.en: This means it is not enough to say "we use a commercial disinfectant and the supplier says it works." You must provide:

blocks.zh: 選擇依據（書面 rationale）
blocks.en: The basis for selection (written rationale)

blocks.zh: 在實際潔淨室條件下的資格驗證數據
blocks.en: Qualification data under actual cleanroom conditions

blocks.zh: 針對設施分離株的有效性確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of effectiveness against facility isolates

blocks.zh: 持續監測趨勢（EM 數據）
blocks.en: Ongoing monitoring trends (EM data)

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 無菌指南的核心要求
blocks.en: Core Requirements of the FDA 2004 Aseptic Guidance

blocks.zh: 該指南要求廠商評估消毒劑的三個面向：
blocks.en: The guidance requires manufacturers to evaluate disinfectants on three aspects:

blocks.zh: Suitability（適用性）：藥劑是否適合該環境、基質與目標微生物？
blocks.en: Suitability: is the agent appropriate for the environment, the substrate and the target microorganisms?

blocks.zh: Efficacy（有效性）：是否有數據證明在 GMP 條件下有效？
blocks.en: Efficacy: is there data showing it is effective under GMP conditions?

blocks.zh: Limitations（侷限性）：哪些情況下不適用？對哪些微生物效果有限？
blocks.en: Limitations: in what situations is it not applicable? Against which microorganisms is its effect limited?

blocks.zh: 稽核時，這三項通常體現在消毒劑 Qualification Report 中。
blocks.en: During an audit, these three items are usually reflected in the disinfectant qualification report.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022 修訂版）的演進
blocks.en: The Evolution of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 Revision)

blocks.zh: TR70 引用的是舊版 Annex 1，但 2022 年 Annex 1 大幅更新，對消毒計畫的要求更為具體，包括：
blocks.en: TR70 cites the old version of Annex 1, but the 2022 Annex 1 was substantially updated and is more specific about disinfection programs, including:

blocks.zh: 明確要求殺孢子劑定期使用（Grade A/B）
blocks.en: Explicit requirement for periodic use of sporicides (Grade A/B)

blocks.zh: 要求記錄消毒劑選擇依據
blocks.en: Requirement to document the rationale for disinfectant selection

blocks.zh: 要求評估環境分離株的敏感性
blocks.en: Requirement to evaluate the susceptibility of environmental isolates

blocks.zh: 在應用 TR70 指引時，應同步對照最新版 Annex 1 要求。
blocks.en: When applying TR70, cross-check it against the requirements of the latest version of Annex 1.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核準備清單
blocks.en: CDMO Audit Preparation Checklist

blocks.zh: 消毒劑選擇書面依據 (written rationale)
blocks.en: Written rationale for disinfectant selection

blocks.zh: 各潔淨等級區域適用的藥劑清單
blocks.en: List of agents suitable for each cleanliness grade area

blocks.zh: 每種藥劑的內部資格驗證報告 (qualification report)
blocks.en: In-house qualification report for each agent

blocks.zh: 接觸時間、濃度、使用方法的 SOP
blocks.en: SOPs for contact time, concentration and method of use

blocks.zh: 藥劑輪替計畫 (rotation schedule)
blocks.en: Agent rotation schedule

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢分析 — 顯示消毒程序有效性
blocks.en: EM trend analysis demonstrating the effectiveness of the disinfection program

blocks.zh: Change control 記錄（藥劑更換時）
blocks.en: Change control records (when an agent is changed)

blocks.zh: 人員培訓記錄 (in-use testing 含操作人員)
blocks.en: Personnel training records (in-use testing including operators)

blocks.zh: 監管框架全景
blocks.en: Regulatory Framework Overview

blocks.zh: TR70 所引用的法規構成一個層次分明的監管框架：
blocks.en: The regulations cited by TR70 form a clearly layered regulatory framework:

blocks.zh: 核心重點摘要
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: TR70 規範非產品接觸面的清潔與消毒，不涵蓋 CIP/COP（詳見 TR29、TR49）
blocks.en: TR70 governs cleaning and disinfection of non-product-contact surfaces and does not cover CIP/COP (see TR29 and TR49)

blocks.zh: 殺菌劑 / 消毒劑 / 殺孢子劑三層次，等級越高適用越嚴格的潔淨區（Grade A 必須使用殺孢子劑）
blocks.en: Three levels of sanitizer / disinfectant / sporicide: the higher the level, the stricter the cleanroom grade it suits (Grade A must use a sporicide)

blocks.zh: 市售標示有效性不等於 GMP 有效性 — 必須進行符合潔淨室實際條件的內部資格驗證
blocks.en: Label efficacy claims are not GMP efficacy: in-house qualification under actual cleanroom conditions is required

blocks.zh: 主要法規依據：21 CFR 211、FDA 無菌指南 2004、EU GMP Annex 1、USP <1072>
blocks.en: Main regulatory sources: 21 CFR 211, FDA Aseptic Guidance 2004, EU GMP Annex 1, USP <1072>

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核成功關鍵：書面選擇依據 + 驗證數據 + 輪替計畫 + EM 趨勢證明
blocks.en: Key to CDMO audit success: written selection rationale + qualification data + rotation plan + EM trends as proof
